$comment: Machine-readable PR body section spec (TCK-20260924-DELIVERY-CONTRACT-AND-TEMPLATES, plan.md §3.6). TCK-20260924-DELIVERY-PR-RENDERER consumes this instead of hardcoding the layout, so the renderer and .github/pull_request_template.md cannot disagree. Order is the order sections appear in the PR body.

sections.heading: ## What landed
sections.source: batch theme, or the single ticket's Request Summary

sections.heading: ## Tickets
sections.source: table of ticket id/tier/title for every ticket on the branch

sections.heading: ## Verification
sections.source: scoped test commands + results, done_checker_static result, and known gaps per ticket

sections.heading: ## Review notes
sections.source: hand-written: what to look at first, judgement calls made

sections.heading: Closes:
sections.source: TCK- ids of every ticket on the branch, comma-separated, body only -- never the PR title (plan §3.5)
